responsibility: Objective-C++ front-end language-hook definition file. It registers the `GNU Objective-C++` lang_hooks instance by combining Objective-C initialization and expression gimplification hooks with the shared C++/ObjC++ hook set, sets the language kind to `clk_objcxx`, initializes tree codes for both Objective-C and C++ nodes, and provides the ObjC++-specific template-substitution helper that recognizes Objective-C-only tree forms such as `MESSAGE_SEND_EXPR` and `CLASS_REFERENCE_EXPR`, rebuilding them through Objective-C semantic routines before falling back to normal C++ template processing.
